text: Based on the evidence, approximately 0.5 hectares of the property's native forest were lost in 2022. This is about 2.84% of the total 17.6-hectare property. The loss was mapped by Hansen/UMD and corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data. However, it's important to note that this data does not specify the cause of the loss or whether it was legal or illegal.
